grounding.from: The Sienna gets 36 mpg combined in front-wheel drive. It's the only minivan offered only as a hybrid.

value.answer: My pick is the 2026 Honda Odyssey. U.S. News has it #1 at 9.3 out of 10, Edmunds says it's the one they most like driving, and Car Talk's staff picked it too. If fuel economy matters most, look at the Toyota Sienna instead. It's standard hybrid, gets 36 mpg combined, and Edmunds ranks it #1 at 7.8. These are the U.S. rankings.
